x: The individual title, appropriately on his home course, was won by Ronny Wallwork with Shaun Lightman 2nd and a surprised Arthur Jones 3rd. Ray Middleton was first Belgrave man home hotly pursued by Bob Barnes.
Ray middleton walked a great race to take third place, just over a minute behind a stylish Arthur Jones who was himself only 40 seconds from the winner Ronny Wallwork.
His fifth place put him only 40 yards behind 2 miles holder Arthur Jones and was nearly a half minute faster than Ray Middleton's best of last year.

Pat Duncan was beaten into second place at Steyning by Arthur Jones although his time 2.58 odd was a big improvement. In the Surrey Ray Middleton was content to take it easy behind an inspired Paul Nihill who improves every time out.

Starting steadily Ray stormed through the field and took 1m 20secs off a shattered Arthur Jones over the last 5 Kilos. Had the race been better organised ( Jones had been dropped at 7 Kms only to find himself in the lead again when the leaders were misdirected) Ray would almost certaily have caught…

The individual race at once developed into a scrap between Arthur Jones of Brighton and John Webb from Basildon. These two, both fresh from Mexico disputed the lead until the final hill where Jones pulled clear to finish a comfortable winner.
